test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Manoj said to Mira, "Do not try to make a fool of me".

options.text: Manoj told Mira not to try to make a fool of him.
Manoj told Mira to not try to make a fool of me.
Manoj told Mira do not try to make a fool of him.
Manoj told Mira to not to try to make a fool of me.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Manoj told Mira not to try to make a fool of him.'**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an imperative sentence.
 
• Let's look at the rules of transformation:
 
• While changing the narration of an imperative sentence, we need to follow the given steps:
 
• The conjunction 'to' should be used in place of a comma (,) and inverted commas (“ ”). 
 
• Here, 'don't' will be changed into 'not to'.
 
• 'said to' will be changed into 'told'.
 
• 'to' is followed by 'V1 (try)'.
 
• '**me**' will be changed into '**him**' because the** first person pronoun **is changed according to the **subject** of the** reporting verb.**
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *The queen said to her servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)*
 
• *The queen ordered her servant to cook her some delicious food that day. (Indirect Speech)*

 
 
 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ Manoj told Mira not to try to make a fool of him.*
